description: Permissions for the Void windows (main + updater + tray-menu). Phase 1 — window controls. Phase 2 — tray, menu, notifications, autostart, global-shortcut. Updater v2 — frameless updater window reuses the same window/event perms. tray-menu — custom frameless tray context menu (hide/show/set-position/set-size + tray_menu_action command). External links (chat, settings footer, download banner) open via the custom open_external command (Rust-side opener plugin — no JS ACL needed).
